Per-CoC Point-in-Time homeless counts by shelter status, 2007-2025

Source: R/pit_coc.R
pit_coc.Rd

HUD Point-in-Time (PIT) homeless counts for each Continuum of Care (CoC) and year, split into sheltered and unsheltered components (sheltered + unsheltered = total), in long format. Complements the CoC-total hud2007 objects and the national pit_us series.

Usage

pit_coc

Format

A data frame with one row per CoC-year and 9 variables:

coc_num

CoC number, e.g. "WA-500".

year

Year of the count.

total

Overall homeless (PIT), as published by HUD.

sheltered

Sheltered homeless, as published by HUD.

unsheltered

Unsheltered homeless, as published by HUD.

total_imp

sheltered + unsheltered_imp. Equals total except where unsheltered_imputed is TRUE.

unsheltered_imp

Unsheltered homeless with the 2021 waiver gap imputed. Equals unsheltered except where unsheltered_imputed is TRUE.

unsheltered_imputed

TRUE if unsheltered_imp is an imputed value, not a HUD count. Only ever TRUE in 2021.

imputation_method

"arima_kalman", or "log_linear_interp" for series too short to fit an ARIMA; NA for HUD counts.

Source

HUD AHAR Part 1 PIT estimates, from the PIT-by-CoC workbook (see hud2007). Imputation: data-raw/14_unsheltered_imputation.R.

Details

2021: HUD waived the unsheltered count for many CoCs during COVID-19, so many CoCs report 0 unsheltered in 2021. The official columns keep HUD's figures; unsheltered_imp / total_imp carry a flagged imputation (see the section below).

Imputed 2021 unsheltered counts

HUD's COVID-19 waiver let CoCs skip the 2021 unsheltered count, and many report 0. The _imp columns carry an estimate for those CoC-years; HUD's official total, sheltered and unsheltered are never modified. A 2021 zero is imputed only when the CoC counted unsheltered people in the years either side (159 CoCs); the estimate is a once-differenced ARIMA on log(1 + unsheltered) with Kalman smoothing, so both earlier and later years inform it. In a holdout test (2019 and 2023 hidden and re-imputed for the same CoCs) it was 3-4% low in total with a 15-17% median per-CoC error. Use the official columns to reproduce HUD; use the _imp columns for trends across 2021. The same note is attached to the data as attr(x, "note"). See vignette("unsheltered-imputation", package = "COCHomeless").
